# Scribble Club

> A real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game for browsers.

Scribble Club lets players create public or private rooms, invite friends with a room code, draw prompts, and guess each other's drawings.

## Technology

- React and TypeScript client, built with Vite.
- Node.js and Express server.
- Socket.IO for real-time rooms, drawing synchronization, and chat.

## Game behavior

- The server controls turns, word privacy, timers, guesses, and scores.
- Room settings include player count, rounds, draw time, word choices, hints, and word mode.
- Game rooms are stored in memory and are not persistent across server restarts.

## Links

- [Play Scribble Club](https://scrribleclub.onrender.com/)
